title: decision: an exact `?package=X` read of a doc X does not hold, while another package does: 404 (card #34247) or the 409 refusal naming the holders (ADR-0150 D5)?
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Ruled: 6917064203 · letter B · 2026-11-16T12:58Z

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make. Card #34247's acceptance sentence and the accepted ADR-0150 D5 text answer one address differently; contract review FAIL 6916685896 on PR #34347 (finding M2) routes the choice to the maintainer. Reader who acts: area o1-D's fix round on PR #34347 (branch `claude/area-E1b-34247`), right after the ruling. Dedupe: `is:issue "package" doc 404 409 holders` → 86 hits, read the top 8 (#33210, #34144, #33955, #34247, #34059, #34262, #31527, #34040); none asks this; `is:issue label:needs-user-decision qualifier` → 0.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：文档请求写明「要 X 包的这一篇」，但 X 包没有这篇，别的包 Y 有。今天平台悄悄把 Y 的那篇给出去。要改成拒绝，但拒绝的样子有两种写法互相矛盾：卡 #34247 写「找不到（404）」，已接受的 ADR-0150 D5 写「拒绝并列出谁持有（409，带候选）」。
- A：回 404「找不到」。读者走到死胡同，不知道 Y 有这篇。
- B（推荐）：回 409，列出持有者 Y。控制台文档页已经会把候选列成可点的列表；流程、动作等已按包寻址的类型对同样的请求本来就回这个 409。
- C：维持现状（给出 Y 的那篇）。不取：作者写错包名会静默拿到别人的内容，正是 #34040 要消灭的。
- 推荐 B：一条规则覆盖所有类型，拒绝带处方，与 ADR 原文一致；工作量在同一个 PR 内一轮修复。

## Background

PR #34347 (cards #34247 and #34248) narrows `GET /meta/doc/N?package=X`: on `main`, when X ships no doc N and package Y does, the read answers 200 with Y's doc (the registry's prefer-local fallback, measured on the composed artifact rig by the #34040 dev). The same holds for every type the exact qualifier does not judge by package: doc, view, translation, field, seed, datasource, external_catalog, object_extension (the family PR #34241 enumerates). The PR answers 404 there, because the card's acceptance 1 says "answers 404".

## Governing text

- ADR-0150 D5, metadata row: "`?package=X` kept as the exact qualifier: X's item with its bound overlay, **or a refusal that names the holders**, never X's closure; D2 ruling `6724570466`" (`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`, D5 table).
- ADR-0150 D5 amendment note (#32362): a reader that is not installed "gets exactly what `?package=ID` answers (`409` naming the holders, or the read's miss)".
- Card #34247 acceptance 1: "An exact `?package=X` read of a name X holds no item of answers 404".
- #34040 acceptance (closed): "X's doc or 404, never another holder's". That sentence predates the question of what X-holds-nothing-but-Y-does answers; it rules out 200, not 409.

Prior rulings read: exact qualifier, names the holders, package → 107 ADR hits, read ADR-0150 D2/D5 and the #32362 note; ADR-0150 D5; thread: none (0 rulings of 3 comments on #34247).

## Protocol

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) under every option but C. A and B both narrow 200 to a refusal; they differ in which refusal. No spec schema changes under A or B: the 409 body is the existing `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.candidates` (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`, reason `not-held-by-qualifier`).

## Premises (re-check)

- Covered types already answer 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` for this address shape: PR #34347's own COVERED control; `grep -rn "not-held-by-qualifier" packages --include=*.ts | grep -v test`.
- Console renders a 409 doc read as a candidate list: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` `conflictCandidates` (reads `details.candidates` of a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`).
- A name no package and no environment row holds answers the read's own 404 under every option.

## Options

| Option | What happens | What the customer sees | Work |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A · 404 (card) | `?package=X`, X holds nothing, Y holds N → 404 for the eight uncovered types; the covered types keep their 409 | A Console doc link or an API/AI read that names the wrong package gets "not found", with no hint that Y has it | none beyond PR #34347's current round (+410/−43 at `989f4ad7`) |
| B · 409 naming holders (ADR D5) | same address → 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, candidates = the holders | Console lists the holders, one click opens the right doc; an AI or script reads the candidates and retries with the right package | server lane · same PR · one more fix round swapping the answer on `readMetaItem`, `/layers` and the carry-forward, plus the changeset rows. No measured precedent for this exact swap; closest landed: #34147 (+771/−53), which introduced the `?package=` holder refusal on the diff door |
| C · keep 200 | Y's doc is served under X's address | silently the wrong package's content | none; #34247 and the open half of #34040's acceptance stay unmet |

Business meaning, one line each:
- A: asking a librarian for "Smith's edition" of a book the library only has in Jones's edition, and being told "we don't have it".
- B: being told "not Smith's; Jones's edition is on shelf 4".
- C: being handed Jones's edition with Smith's label on it.

## Four facets

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- ① Long-term soundness: B keeps one answer for one address across every metadata type (covered types already answer 409), and it is the ADR's own sentence; A adds a per-type split (eight types 404, the rest 409) that a later card would have to unify. End state in two years: one exact-address rule for every metadata type, so a reader never has to know which types are package-scoped to interpret the answer. Reference read: the platform's own covered types (flow, action, page and the rest of ADR-0150 bucket 2), which already answer this way; I read no external platform for this.
- ② Business pull: today's first consumer is the Console doc page. ADR-0046 cross-references from app X's doc to another package's doc, and docs under multi-app packages, read with the app's address; with A they show "not found", with B they show the holder list (finding M2 on PR #34347).
- ③ Guarding against AI mistakes: an AI that names the wrong package gets, with B, a loud refusal that carries the fix (the candidates); with A, a 404 that reads like "this doc does not exist", which invites the AI to create a duplicate.
- ④ Startup-stage containment: B reuses the existing refusal vocabulary (`not-held-by-qualifier`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates`) and adds nothing to declare; A creates a second answer for the same address that has to be documented and kept apart.

## Recommendation

B. Only looking at ①: B. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Confidence gap: I read no external platform's convention (some, such as Kubernetes namespaces, answer a plain not-found for an object in another namespace, which leans toward A). I also did not measure what the eight uncovered types' Studio editors do with a 409 (the doc page is the only reader I read); the decision thread may want that read before the ruling.

Not taken: A, because it leaves a dead end where the ADR promised a refusal with candidates and splits the types; C, because it is the defect the card exists to remove.

Analysis-tier: seat tier; the decision thread re-reads before taking it to the maintainer.

## After the ruling

- A: PR #34347 keeps its 404; the area records the ruling on #34247, the changeset cites it, review#2 deltas the rest of FAIL 6916685896, then L1 and landing.
- B: the area's dev swaps the answer to 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the holders on the three reads, re-pins both registration orders, updates the changeset FROM→TO rows (200 → 409), then the same review path. Card #34247's acceptance 1 is amended by a comment citing the ruling.
- C: PR #34347 drops the #34247 half; #34247 closes as ruled.

## Related

Cards #34247, #34248, #34040 (closed); PRs #34347 (open, FAIL 6916685896), #34241 (merged), #34147 (merged); ADR-0150 D2/D5.
